verdict: No paid ads running; organic profile activity is softening this week.
narrative: There was no paid advertising spend on Meta or Google Ads during the last 28 days, so all activity came from your Google Business Profile. That profile generated 52 actions this period — 36 direction requests and 16 website clicks — but GBP activity dropped 35% in the most recent 7 days compared to the 7 days before, and website sessions have followed a similar downward trend with no paid traffic to offset it. Without paid support, organic visibility alone is not holding steady. Paid campaigns are being prepared to reintroduce consistent traffic and lead flow in the coming period.
